blend.backbone: germanic (frankish / Old High German register: kuning/herizogo, dithematic -o/-i names, High German shift th>d / d>t / k>ch-hh, retained w, comes-and-herizogo crusader register)
blend.overlay: near_eastern (egyptian: the itru river-land, the per-netjer temple-houses, the niut river-cities, construct toponyms Per-/Niut-/Ta-, breathy vowels and dj/tj/kh, aspect-based strong verbs over the substrate)
blend.lean: Germanic-heavy - a Frankish crusader-dynasty enthroned on the Nile: a war-host of comites and herizogen seized the river-cities and set themselves up as feudal kings over the temple-priesthood and the scribal populace; the knights rule, the per-temples and the river-kingdom endure and serve beneath.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_01 Thiodmark (Germanic) x BASE_05 (Egyptian / abydosian river-kingdom). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Germanic base = Clanhold, Egyptian base = Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Kemetric is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a Frankish crusader-dynasty enthroned on the Nile - Germanic knights and a feudal court (the comites and herizogen of a Damietta-on-the-river crusader state) ruling over the existing temple-priesthood, scribes, and river-cities of the Egyptian kingdom. Backbone = Germanic (FRANKISH/Old High German: the ruling war-aristocracy, the kuning/herizogo/comes register, dithematic -o/-i names, the High German consonant shift th>d / d>t / k>ch-hh); overlay/substrate = Egyptian (the itru river, the per-netjer temples, the niut river-cities, the scribal and priestly populace, the Per-/Niut-/Ta- construct toponyms). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Frankish (Old High German) and Egyptian registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (FRANKISH reflexes primary - the family_germanic theonym_ancestors frankish column; Egyptian morphs secondary - the abydosian deity-morphs), never real Germanic/Egyptian gods. PROVISIONAL: alignment (Lawful/Neutral) is a per-hybrid design choice pending the alignment pass - the Frankish crusader-oath order (the sworn knighthood of a Lawful high-king) meets the Egyptian right-order / maa-kheru funerary tradition; the older heathen and funerary layer reads Neutral. Register choice: the Germanic ruling layer is the FRANKISH special case (not the default Gothic), rationale = the Frankish/Latin crusader states on the Nile (Damietta); flag for Jedidiah if a uniform Germanic register is wanted instead. [UPDATE 2026-06-27: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (per-hybrid alignment restriction removed). Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are now English (or an approved foreign term); conlang titles moved to ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. Deities unchanged: canonical Agrippan pantheon via the per-family morph method.]

phonology.palette: Germanic (Frankish / Old High German) backbone - heavy root-initial stress, sharp stops, the High German consonant shift (th>d, d>t, k>ch/hh; e.g. *Thulraz > Dulro), retained w, dithematic compounding, -o/-i endings - meeting an Egyptian overlay: dj/tj/kh, l tends to r, v tends to w, the long -aa and feminine -et endings, breathy reconstructed vowels (a e i o u). Per the CSV: breathy vowels cutting through consonant clusters; grammar is SVO with aspect-based strong verbs (the Egyptian substrate aspect-marking carried on Frankish strong/weak stems). Theophoric on the Frankish reflexes (Dulro-, Erlant-) with Egyptian construct variants (Tjuraa-, Djeroraa-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; Frankish clusters (st, hh, br, chn) shifted by the High German pattern, meeting Egyptian dj/tj/kh onsets and long -aa codas; heavy initial stress with a breathy Egyptian vowel-quality cutting the clusters; dithematic Frankish names over Per-/Niut-/Ta- construct toponyms.

fusion_rules.lean: germanic (frankish / Old High German) phonology dominant
sound_changes: Egyptian dj/tj/kh and breathy onsets -> Frankish inventory: dj>d, tj>z/t, kh>ch-hh, glottal/aleph>0; Egyptian l already tends to r
the High German consonant shift applied to every root from either parent: th>d, d>t, k>ch/hh (e.g. itru>idru, khent>chent, djew>dew)
Egyptian -aa/-et endings adapted or dropped: long -aa>-o/-a or 0, feminine -et>-et/0; roots take a Frankish -o/-i where too short
Frankish root-initial stress on all words; Frankish clusters (st, br, chn, hh) permitted; breathy Egyptian vowel-quality retained between clusters
retain Frankish w, hh and the -o/-i endings, and an audible Egyptian per-/niut- and the breathy a-e-o vowels; v>w throughout
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/river/desert/material/staple words from Egyptian roots (the river-folk and scribes work the black land - itru, deshret, nebu, it); kin-line/quality/abstract/rule/war words from Frankish (Old High German) roots (the crusader ruling register - michil, swarz, isarn, heri); every root then filtered to one Frankish-shaped phonology

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Egyptian land/river/material roots + Frankish (Old High German) rule/kin/war-roots, all run through one Frankish-shaped sound-law with the High German consonant shift; portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline. One word per concept, no slashes.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Frankish ruling house keeps a dithematic lineage-name and -ingo/-ingun; the Egyptian populace keep the 'sa-' (son of) filiation and theophoric constructs; the throne fuses both - a kuning who also carries a Per- house-name.
morphology.compounding_rule: Frankish dithematic ([quality](stem) + element: Isarn-burg, iron-fort) layered over Egyptian construct-chains (Per-[god], Niut-[god], Ta-[noun]): the capital Niltreich (the Nile-realm), Per-Dulro (temple-city of Dulro), Ta-Erlant (the iron-land).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Frankish crusader-aristocracy over the Egyptian river-kingdom: the kuning and his herizogen at the crown, the comites and grafen over the niut-cities, the dganman-knights sworn to the war-host; the hem-netjer priesthood and the scribal per-aat serve beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Frankish (Old High German) ladder, ascending, with the Egyptian substrate co-titles beneath. Comes (the king's-companion count) barony; Marcho-graf (march-count) march; Graf (count) county over a Grafscaf; Herizogo (war-leader / duke; *harja-tugon) duchy; Furisto (the foremost / prince) principality; Kuning (king) kingdom over a Kuningrichi; Keisar-Nesut (the emperor-king; Frk. keisar < Caesar + Eg. nesut) empire over the Keisartuom. The conquered river-cities keep their Egyptian sepati (nomarch) and hem-netjer (priest) beneath the Frankish crown; the per-aa style survives as the highest sacral honorific of the enthroned kuning. The Egyptian wab and hem-netjer stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Frankish and Egyptian registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Kuning-barn (the king's child; the heir); Sa-Nesut (king's son, Egyptian style)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Frankish ruling stock carry a dithematic name + -ingo lineage; the Egyptian populace carry a theophoric given name + sa- filiation; order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Frankish war-aristocracy keep Old High German dithematic names (Hrod-, Adal-, -rich, -mund, -o); the Egyptian river-folk keep theophoric names (X-hotep, Mery-X, Sa-X) on the morphed canon-stems.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Frankish devotional on the morphed Frankish reflexes (Dulro-mund, Erlant-rich); Egyptian devotional constructs: Tjuraa-hotep (Tjuraa-is-content), Mery-Djeroraa (beloved-of-Djeroraa), Sa-Riaret (son-of-Riaret).

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - FRANKISH (Old High German) reflexes PRIMARY (family_germanic theonym_ancestors, the frankish column), Egyptian morphs SECONDARY (the abydosian deity-morphs), never real Germanic/Egyptian gods. Alignment PROVISIONAL (Lawful/Neutral): the Frankish crusader-oath order (the sworn knighthood of a Lawful high-king) meets the Egyptian right-order / maa-kheru funerary tradition; the older heathen-and-funerary layer reads Neutral.
religion.the_one: Aiterno (Frankish; Eg. Atjernaa) - the distant Ancient One, the hidden maker, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Dulro (Eg. Tjuraa) - the sun, right-order and judgment
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Giando (Eg. Geandaa) - the enduring earth, the black alluvial land
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numino (Eg. Numenaa) - sky, lightning and scribe-wisdom
sample_deity_renames.Delorum / death-lord: Djeroraa (Frk. Deloro) - lord of the peaceful dead

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aiterno, Dulro the just (the sun above the feather of right-order), Erlant of the sworn crusade, Rialda the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers tiufala (devils) / Hefau-kin, warded and unworshipped; the sworn knighthood and the just high-king are the social ideal
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the deified knights of the ruling house) and the akhu / justified dead of the per-temples; the great powers invoked at the alah-grove and the per-netjer situationally rather than worshipped wholesale
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Aiterno - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as tiufala (Frankish devils) or framed as -kin of the great serpent Hefau (Egyptian), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marach the War-Brand (Eg. Marakhu the City-Burner); Vacidus -> Wachid the Unmaker (Eg. Wakedjet, the Devouring Hefau); Lusanto -> Lusando the Hoard-Worm.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Alah (Frankish grove-temple) or Per-netjer (Egyptian god's-house) of [power]: 'the Alah of Dulro', 'the Per-netjer of Tjuraa'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified war-dead of the crusader-house (honored at the howe and on the tomb-stele) and the akhu / justified dead (maa-kheru) of the river-kingdom, venerated at the tomb-temples and the per-netjer.

holy_symbol_motifs.Erlant: an iron crusader-sword crossed with the river-standard
holy_symbol_motifs.Giando: the black alluvial field beneath the temple-pylon
